newsitem.title: USA: Wisconsin Central order 100 new boxcars.
newsitem.headline: Wisconsin Central order 100 new boxcars.

text.p: Wisconsin Central Ltd, a unit of Wisconsin Central Transportation Corp, said Thursday it was investing almost $7.0 million for 100 new boxcars for the paper industry.
The new cars are 13 feet high inside and are designed especially for the paper industry, which last year accounted for about one-half of the railroad's revenues, it added.
Wisconsin Central said the cars will be built in Nova Scotia by the Trenton Works of Greenbrier Cos Inc of Portland, Ore.
Wisconsin Central serves 48 pulp and paper mills in Wisconsin, the Upper Peninsula of Michigan and Ontario.
